verdict.rationale: This is an Agent Skill (a SKILL.md folder, also installable as a Claude plugin), and a skill or plugin package could plausibly declare or consume MCP servers, so the axis applies. The evidence only describes bundled dependency-free Python tools, a local SVG reference library and the host agent loading the skill. Nothing shows the product itself connecting to MCP servers or using their tools, and any MCP support of the host agent is a host-platform capability that earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
